name: Internal seams
description: The places this project keeps to one implementation, and means to go on keeping.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Where.of
contracts.description: The one place a path a reader is handed is made.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Locations.of
contracts.description: Where a name first appears, for a key that names one kind of thing.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Locations.all_in
contracts.description: The one scan of a structured specification for where its names appear.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Locations::Cursor#line_of
contracts.description: Taking each name in the order it was written, for a key that names more than one kind of thing.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Parser.of
contracts.description: The one place a file is matched to the parser that answers for it.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Parser.reads?
contracts.description: The one place a run answers whether this build reads the format a file is written in.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Language.comments_in
contracts.description: The reading of what a person wrote for another person, whatever the file is written in.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Language.attached_comments_in
contracts.description: The reading of where a claim could sit, for a file whose language has code for a comment to sit in front of.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Language.declarations_in
contracts.description: The reading of what a piece of source declares, as the language a specification named.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Language.declarations_of
contracts.description: The reading of what a piece of text declares, for a shape a specification wrote rather than a file.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Language.carries?
contracts.description: The one place a run answers whether this build reads the language a specification named.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Language.definable?
contracts.description: The one place a name is judged against how a language spells what it defines.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Marker.claims_in
contracts.description: The reading of what a piece of source claims, for an interface no construct of the language points at.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Grammar.captures_in
contracts.description: The one place a query is put to a grammar for what a file holds.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Grammar.captures_of
contracts.description: The one place a query is put to a grammar for a piece of text no file holds.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Definitions.matches_in
contracts.description: The one place a reading's captures are grouped by the match they came from.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Definitions.nodes_in
contracts.description: The one place matches become the nodes a file declares.

contracts.name: Sumitsubo::Definitions.enclosing
contracts.description: The one place nesting is recovered from where the nodes sit.
